scope: All 59 original researched deployments. The 58 reactivated records retain exact original addresses, protocols and decimals; the unresolved Avalanche PEPE deployment was removed at the user's explicit request.
decision_policy: Activate issuer/protocol documented deployments or verified official bridge mappings after matching chain identity, contract bytecode and precision. On-chain origin alone does not establish the operator or issuer identity of an arbitrary bridge wrapper.

deployments.identity_note: Exact original Avalanche PepeOFT is its own ERC-20 token (token()=self). Pinned chain-identity-checked peers(30101) returns Ethereum adapter0x5a026ea79cda77007a474d7e5b66a663721f7979; that adapter's peers(30106) reciprocally returns the Avalanche token, and token() returns issuer-authenticated Ethereum PEPE0x6982508145454ce325ddbe47a25d4ec3d2311933. Verified source confirms LayerZero OFT and OFTAdapter implementations and immutable canonical token/endpoint constructor arguments. Official LayerZero documentation defines these trusted peer channels and adapter locking/unlocking semantics. This version is separate from the Arbitrum/BNB endpoint v1 OFT; issuer endorsement of the bridge is not asserted. The wrapper origin and reciprocal bridge relation are proven, but official issuer/bridge-operator attribution remains unresolved. The user explicitly requested removal of this deployment from the catalog; these readings remain as research history.
deployments.bridge_version: Third-party LayerZero endpoint v2 OFT bridge: Avalanche PepeOFT ↔ Ethereum PepeOFTAdapter
